intended_object: An auxiliary canonical isomorphism. It identifies the evaluation at a stage i of a diagram of flasque-resolution complexes, indexed by a filtered category, with the functorial flasque resolution of F.obj i. This is read off from the docstring and the name.
explanation: This declaration does not define a mathematical object. It is a comparison isomorphism that holds by definition: it is built with `Hom.isoOfComponents` from identity isomorphisms (`Iso.refl`) in each degree. Its role is bookkeeping inside the proof that sheaf cohomology commutes with filtered colimits, namely rewriting the evaluated complex as `flasqueResolution (F.obj i)`. It has no counterpart in the literature that it would be meant to formalize, so neither `faithful` nor `too_narrow` applies.
